piecewise_linear_target.description: Caps early-life RUL to keep healthy phases constant and linearly degrades after the wear threshold.

variables.y_t: Target RUL label at current time t
variables.T_fail: Total time step or cycle at failure

linear_degradation.description: Calculates RUL assuming a constant rate of degradation over time.

variables.S_t: Current health indicator reading at time t
variables.RUL_t: Estimated remaining useful life at time t

exponential_degradation.description: Calculates RUL assuming exponential acceleration of component wear over time.

variables.S_t: Current health indicator reading at time t
variables.RUL_t: Estimated remaining useful life at time t

root_mean_squared_error.description: Standard symmetric loss function evaluating average prediction magnitude error.

variables.y_i: Actual RUL label for sample i

asymmetric_penalty_loss.latex: L = \frac{1}{N} \sum_{i=1}^{N} l_i, \quad l_i = \begin{cases} \exp\left(-\frac{\hat{y}_i - y_i}{a_1}\right) - 1 & \text{if } \hat{y}_i - y_i < 0 \\ \exp\left(\frac{\hat{y}_i - y_i}{a_2}\right) - 1 & \text{if } \hat{y}_i - y_i \ge 0 \end{cases}
asymmetric_penalty_loss.description: Penalizes overestimating RUL (late predictions) exponentially harder than underestimating (early predictions).

variables.y_i: Actual RUL label for sample i
variables.a1: Penalty scaling factor for early predictions (underestimation, e.g., 13)
variables.a2: Penalty scaling factor for late predictions (overestimation, e.g., 10)
